system.notes:
A towering, multi-headed desert worm with segmented armor hide. The older a hydra worm gets, the more heads it sprouts from past injuries. Statted here with three heads; adjust LV and HP to match the number of heads you give it.

AC 16, HP 30, ATK 1 bite (near) +8 (1d12 + swallow), MV double near (burrow), S +5, D +1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6

Heads. Choose how many heads the worm has. Each is LV 2, AC 16, HP 9, and can make 1 bite attack. A killed head sprouts into two new heads at the start of the worm’s turn unless cauterized beforehand. The worm’s LV and total HP is that of all the heads combined.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 18-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside and 2d10 damage per round. Worm regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage in one round to the inside of its gullet.

Art by Ricardo Gabriel Telles, 2023
